steps.action: Last Administrator safeguard: the only active Administrator cannot be demoted, and archiving that account is refused
steps.expected: "You cannot demote the last Administrator." and "You cannot archive the last Administrator."
steps.actual: On bwiz DOC-032 bridge Avery Morgan is the only active Administrator (1). Choosing Legal team member on the own row showed "You cannot demote the last Administrator." and the role stayed administrator. The own row has no Archive and no … button, so the archive refusal was read from the archive route: 409 "You cannot archive the last Administrator.".
